t: A battery-powered Linux computer shaped like a conference badge with an e-paper screen.
steps: Order a BeagleBadge from Seeed Studio or another listed seller.
Get a single-cell BL-5C style battery and a microSD card.
Download the Armbian BeagleBadge demo image from the BeagleBoard site.
Write the image to the microSD card with a free SD card writing app.
Insert the card, connect USB-C power and wait for the screen to update.
Connect from your computer and run a short Python script that prints text.
Ask for help on the BeagleBoard forum.
Try the upstream Zephyr board guide next.
meta: Open Board. From $99. A few stores.
